name: suede-sms
description: Suede AI SMS and MMS marketing discipline: whether SMS fits, consent-aware flows (welcome, cart recovery, post-purchase, win-back), exact message copy with segment counts, cadence and quiet hours, number types and platforms, and measurement, checked against current TCPA opt-out rules and A2P 10DLC registration. Use when evaluating SMS as a channel, designing or auditing a text message program, or drafting texts. NOT FOR: email campaigns (use suede-emails), phone-number capture UX (use suede-site
author: JasonColapietro
